ev.q: A space survival open world terraforming crafting game
Survive, gather resources, and build your base
as the planet changes it opens new areas to explore and new discoveries to make
Honestly the most relaxing game I've ever played
if you're looking for something chill and singleplayer, this is it
The whole thing is somewhat haunting at times
I felt so hopeless all the way through
You're not done when you've finished the first planet either
The core loop feels extremely tedious
it's too tedious to recommend to friends with limited gaming time
